title: GramTrans per-class object census artifact
description: One JSON document per census run. Machine-readable form of the per-class object census required by 038 FR-011, used as the acceptance gate for FR-009/FR-010/FR-012/FR-013 and SC-005/SC-009/SC-010. The human contract, including every rule this schema cannot express, is fidelity-census.md in this directory. The instrument that produces this document does not exist yet; this schema is the contract for it.
$comment: SCHEMA EVOLUTION RULE (keeps a later bump purely additive): 'schema_version' is an integer incremented only for ADDITIVE change. Additive means: new OPTIONAL properties, or new members appended to an existing enum. It NEVER means removing a property, renaming one, changing its type, narrowing an enum, or adding a member to a 'required' list. Because every object here is additionalProperties:false, a consumer pinned to version N validates an N+1 document against the N+1 schema and ignores properties it does not know; it MUST NOT validate an N+1 document against the N schema. A breaking change requires a new $id, not a version bump.

schema_version.$comment: 1 for the first shipped census. See the SCHEMA EVOLUTION RULE above; readers select their validator by this value.

census_id.$comment: Identity of THIS census invocation: 'CENSUS-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS', deliberately distinct in prefix from a transfer run id ('GT-...') so the two can never be confused in a log or a filename.

transfer_run.$comment: The transfer run this census judges. null for a standalone or pre-transfer census; when null, no class row may claim a 'baseline_matched' subtraction basis and no match_basis tally may be non-null (fidelity-census.md 5.2, 8).

classes.$comment: Exactly one row per required class -- length MUST equal class_list_provenance.required_class_count. A class with no instances anywhere is verdict_class NOT_EVALUATED, never an omitted row (FR-012, CP-2). Never truncated.

verdict.$comment: Exactly one per census run, the most severe applicable token by the published severity ordering in fidelity-census.md section 9. The severity ordering is NOT the exit_code integer and must not be derived from it.

exit_code.$comment: Process exit code. Normative verdict->exit_code mapping lives in fidelity-census.md section 9: CENSUS_CLEAN 0, CENSUS_ACCOUNTED 0, UNEXPLAINED_SHORTFALL 1, UNEXPLAINED_SURPLUS 2, DUPLICATE_IDENTITY 3, BASELINE_MISSING 4, BASELINE_STALE 5, COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE 6, CENSUS_ERROR 7. Only 0 reports success.

verdict_human_label.$comment: The console label for 'verdict' (e.g. 'Unexplained shortfall'). Stored so the artifact and the console cannot drift apart; the machine token remains the thing tests assert on.

errors.$comment: Populated for CENSUS_ERROR / COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE. An empty array with a failing verdict is itself invalid: a failure must name its cause.

notes.$comment: Free-text observations for a human reader only. Never load-bearing: no verdict may depend on a note (fidelity-census.md invariant 9). Never truncated.

name.$comment: e.g. 'debug/audit_object_census.py'. PLANNED -- not in the repository at the time this contract was written.

gramtrans_dirty.$comment: true when the working tree carried uncommitted changes. A dirty tree does not invalidate the counts but makes the artifact non-reproducible, so it is recorded rather than inferred.

flexicon_version.$comment: Installed pyflexicon version. Below the 4.4.1 floor every guid= kwarg raises TypeError, which the engine's _safe wrappers swallow into a generic drop -- so a too-low flexicon silently regenerates identities and any census taken over such a run measures the wrong thing.

flexicon_path.$comment: Resolved flexicon.__file__. A site-packages path here means the editable install did not take effect.

flex_version.$comment: Running FieldWorks version, compared against starter_baseline.flex_version for staleness (fidelity-census.md 5.3).

run_id.$comment: The transfer's own run id, format 'GT-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS' as minted by Lib/api.py and stamped into residue markers. The two measured runs are GT-20260819-030049 (Ejagham) and GT-20260819-024027 (Ngoreme).

mode.$comment: A PREVIEW run writes nothing, so a census over one can only legitimately report the destination's prior state.

report_path.$comment: Path to the run report the accounted_for report_refs resolve against. Absent means no report was available, which forces starter_subtraction_basis 'baseline_gross' on every row.

selected_categories.$comment: GrammarCategory names the operator selected. A class whose category is absent here can legitimately account a shortfall as NOT_SELECTED.

name.$comment: FLEx project name exactly as FieldWorks holds it, e.g. 'Ejagham W Mini'. Do not normalise spacing or case.

opened_read_only.$comment: Pinned to true so an artifact produced through a write-enabled handle cannot validate. The census is a pure observer of BOTH projects (fidelity-census.md section 2).

fwdata_sha256_after.$comment: Digest taken after counting. Must equal fwdata_sha256_before; a difference is CENSUS_ERROR, because it means either the census wrote or something else did while it read, and in both cases the counts are not evidence.

data_model_version.$comment: LCM data model version. Used for baseline staleness (fidelity-census.md 5.3).

declared_freshly_created.$comment: Destination only: the operator's declaration that this project was newly created and therefore holds only FLEx starter content. A 'starter_capture' baseline used against a destination where this is false or absent is CENSUS_ERROR -- an edited starter inventory is not disposable.

object_count_total.$comment: All LCM objects in the project, across every class including ones outside the census scope. Context for a reader, never a gate quantity.

inventory_document.$comment: The truth source for 'every class the engine can create': specs/035-fullsweep-fidelity/object-inventory.md, TABLE 1 (65 created classes) and TABLE 2 (24 referenced classes). Owned by feature 035; 038 reads it and does not fork it.

coverage_floor_document.$comment: specs/035-fullsweep-fidelity/contracts/coverage-floor.json -- the machine-readable projection of the inventory (in_scope_classes, currently 69 entries).

natural_key_roster_document.$comment: specs/035-fullsweep-fidelity/contracts/natural-key-identity-roster.json -- decides which classes get gate-failing duplicate detection and which may legitimately report a natural-key match (FR-003, FR-006).

derivation_check.$comment: CP-1: FR-012 coverage is PROVEN, not asserted. On every run the census re-parses the inventory's TABLE 1 + TABLE 2 class columns and asserts set equality against in_scope_classes union excluded_not_measurable. A mismatch is COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE and names the classes.

performed.$comment: Pinned: a census that skipped the derivation cannot make a coverage claim, so it cannot produce a valid artifact.

in_scope_class_count.$comment: Count of coverage-floor in_scope_classes as read (69 at the time of writing).

required_class_count.$comment: MUST equal len(classes) -- this is the normative constraint (invariant 1). The composition is in_scope_class_count (69) + len(census_additions) (3) + the excluded_not_measurable NOT_EVALUATED rows (2) = 74 distinct class names, plus one extra ROW per Amendment A1 owner split (FsFeatStrucType) = 75 rows at the time of writing. The earlier formula in_scope_class_count + len(census_additions) = 72 counted only REQUIRED classes and omitted both the excluded_not_measurable rows that fidelity-census.md:150-152 mandates and the A1 split, so it contradicted MUST equal len(classes). 72 is still checked, separately, as the required-class cardinality.

census_additions.$comment: CP-4: classes 038 measured that the 035 floor omits. A class present in BOTH the floor and this list is COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE, so the ledger cannot become a second truth source.

excluded_not_measurable.$comment: Copied forward from the coverage floor: abstract LCM bases with no factory (MoForm, MoMorphSynAnalysis). Reported as NOT_EVALUATED / ABSENT_BY_CONSTRUCTION rows, never silently omitted.

rationale.$comment: Why the 035 floor omits it. MoAffixProcess: absent from object-inventory.md entirely because the engine has no create path (a truth-source gap, not a corpus gap). PhCode: inventory TABLE 3 ride-along that flexicon's phoneme GetSyncableProperties explicitly does not carry. CmTranslation: reached through the texts path, never projected into the floor.

measured_evidence.$comment: The census-evidence.md section 0 figures that justify admission, e.g. 'Ejagham 13 -> 0, Ngoreme 1 -> 0'.

owed_to_035.$comment: true while feature 035 has not yet absorbed the class into coverage-floor.json. Roster and floor edits must be coordinated with that live session.

starterBaseline.$comment: FR-010 provenance. A missing baseline is the verdict BASELINE_MISSING, never an assumed zero: a zero baseline is a positive claim that the destination shipped empty (Principle IV -- a report must not claim more certainty than its baseline supports).

kind.$comment: pre_transfer_census: a census of the destination taken BEFORE the transfer -- exact by construction and the only kind valid for a destination that is not a fresh project. starter_capture: a per-class census of a genuinely freshly created empty FLEx project. none: recordable, never passable.

path.$comment: For starter_capture, specs/038-transfer-fidelity-gaps/contracts/starter-baseline.json; for pre_transfer_census, the earlier census artifact.

source_census_id.$comment: For kind pre_transfer_census: the census run that produced the baseline, so the chain of evidence is traceable.

flex_version.$comment: FieldWorks version the baseline was captured under. FLEx changes what a new project ships between versions, so a mismatch against instrument.flex_version is BASELINE_STALE.

data_model_version.$comment: A destination whose data_model_version exceeds this is BASELINE_STALE.

class_count.$comment: Number of classes the baseline carries a count for. A class the baseline does not mention is treated as baseline 0 for THAT class only, and the row records it in starter_baseline_source.

carries_natural_keys.$comment: true when the baseline records the natural KEYS of each starter object, not just counts. Required for the matched-subtraction of fidelity-census.md 5.2 and for duplicate detection in section 6; a count-only baseline forces starter_subtraction_basis 'baseline_gross'.

class.$comment: LCM class name WITHOUT the 'I' interface prefix, matching object-inventory.md convention: 'LexEntry', not 'ILexEntry'.

owning_feature_system.$comment: OPTIONAL, and present only on a row split by owning feature system (Amendment A1, fidelity-census.md:650-673). A FieldWorks project has TWO feature systems and both own FsFeatStrucType, so a single summed row is ambiguous: a shortfall in one system is masked by a surplus in the other, which is the same masking defect section 6 rule 2 exists to prevent for duplicate identity. A1 requires the row to CARRY THE OWNER so the two parts are never summed into one gate decision, and this property is that carrier -- the alternative, encoding the owner inside the 'class' string, would put an unvalidated convention where a class name belongs and force every consumer joining on 'class' to prefix-match it. 'class' therefore stays the plain LCM class name on both parts, and the two parts are distinguished by this property alone. Absent on every ordinary row; the same requirement applies to any other class reachable from both feature systems.

engine_can_create.$comment: true when the class appears in object-inventory.md TABLE 1 (or in census_additions as a class the engine SHOULD create). false for the referenced-only classes the inventory records as never created by any path: LexRefType, LexAppendix, PhBdryMarker.

gate_scope.$comment: SC-005's scope is exactly the 'required' rows. An 'advisory' row is counted and reported in full but cannot by itself fail the gate.

in_class_list_via.$comment: Which arm of the class list put this row here (CP-4 traceability).

inventory_tables.$comment: Where object-inventory.md records the class. 'NONE' is meaningful: MoAffixProcess appears in no table because the engine has no create path for it.

source_count.$comment: null only on a NOT_EVALUATED row where the class could not be counted at all; a genuine zero is 0, never null.

starter_baseline_count.$comment: Instances the destination already held before the transfer, per the baseline. 23 for PhPhoneme on a fresh FLEx project.

starter_matched_to_source.$comment: How many of those pre-existing instances the transfer MATCHED to a source object (identity or natural key). null when unknown. This is the field that makes baseline subtraction correct: subtracting the full baseline count is wrong once natural-key matching works, because a matched starter object stands in for a source object rather than being surplus (fidelity-census.md 5.2).

starter_subtraction_basis.$comment: baseline_matched: net = total - (baseline - matched); fully trustworthy. baseline_gross: net = total - baseline, used when no run report is available; caps the run verdict at CENSUS_ACCOUNTED. no_baseline: net = total; the run cannot pass.

starter_baseline_source.$comment: 'absent_from_baseline' records that the baseline document simply does not mention this class, which is a different statement from a measured zero. 'assumed_zero_not_permitted' exists so a validator can reject any artifact that tried it.

destination_count_net.$comment: destination_count_total minus the pre-existing instances that were NOT matched to a source object. May legitimately be negative if the destination lost pre-existing objects, which would itself be a defect.

difference.$comment: THE GATE QUANTITY: destination_count_net - source_count. Sign convention is fixed: negative = SHORTFALL (loss), zero = MATCHED, positive = SURPLUS (excess).

difference_raw.$comment: destination_count_total - source_count, i.e. before any baseline subtraction. Stored so a reader can see both what happened and what it means: PhPhoneme measured difference_raw +23, difference 0.

verdict_class.$comment: Carried explicitly so no reader has to infer intent from the sign of an integer. MATCHED is NOT sufficient for a pass: see 'duplicates'.

not_evaluated_reason.$comment: Required when verdict_class is NOT_EVALUATED. Typically ABSENT_BY_CONSTRUCTION (abstract LCM base), OUT_OF_SCOPE_CLASS (CmAnthroItem), or GOVERNED_BY_OTHER_FEATURE.

accounted_for.$comment: SC-005 accounting. Never truncated. An empty array on a non-zero difference means the difference is fully unexplained -- absence of a line is not an excuse.

unexplained_shortfall.$comment: max(0, -difference) minus the sum of shortfall-direction accounted_for counts. Non-zero on a 'required' row fails the run (R-4).

unexplained_surplus.$comment: max(0, difference) minus the sum of surplus-direction accounted_for counts. Accounting is per direction: a shortfall line never offsets a surplus, and a line on one class never touches another class (no cross-class netting -- MoAffixProcess -13 and MoAffixAllomorph +13 are two failures, not zero).

matchBasis.$comment: FR-006: a natural-key match must be distinguishable from an identity match, in the gate artifact and not merely in report prose. On a 'required' row with basis_source 'run_report', identity + natural_key + created_new + unmatched_reported MUST equal source_count; 'enriched' is a subset of identity + natural_key and is NOT part of that sum. natural_key > 0 for a class absent from the 035 roster is a harness error naming the class.

identity.$comment: Matched by GUID -- the authoritative basis (FR-001). Identity always wins over a natural key; the natural key is consulted only when identity finds nothing.

natural_key.$comment: Matched by the agreed natural key (FR-002), accounted as IDENTITY-SUBSTITUTION in 035's FR-187 terms.

enriched.$comment: Matched objects that GAINED owned children the destination copy lacked (FR-020, FR-022). Distinguishes an enriched item from a created one and from a whole-object skip.

unmatched_reported.$comment: Neither matched nor created, but named in the run report (FR-007). The measured runs had 0 here alongside a 1949-object loss -- that gap between 0 reported and 1949 lost is the Principle I violation this feature exists to close.

ambiguous_key_reported.$comment: Natural key matched more than one destination object. Per the roster's enforcement clause this is a harness error for any entry with key_unique_by_construction false -- never a pick.

basis_source.$comment: 'unavailable' when no run report was supplied; every tally is then null and the row's starter_subtraction_basis is at best baseline_gross.

duplicates.$comment: Why a zero difference is NOT sufficient for a pass. Measured PhPhoneme: difference 0, verdict_class MATCHED, and yet 21 duplicate names -- baseline arithmetic cannot see a duplicate, so a gate built on counts alone would have passed the worst available phoneme outcome (SC-002).

roster_admitted.$comment: true when the class is on the 035 natural-key roster (or is a census_additions class with a stated key). Only admitted classes can FAIL the gate on duplicates; for other classes duplicates are advisory, because a repeated name is not automatically a defect (homographs are legitimate). Admission is by enumeration, exactly as FR-003 requires for matching.

key_definition.$comment: The exact key the grouping used, e.g. 'Name (vernacular alt), case-sensitive'. Recorded because a duplicate claim is only meaningful relative to a stated key.

groups.$comment: Keys held by more than one destination object. 21 on the measured PhPhoneme row.

extra_objects.$comment: sum(group_size - 1) over those groups -- how many objects would have to disappear for the destination to hold one per key. Non-zero and unaccounted on an admitted class is DUPLICATE_IDENTITY.

examples.$comment: Never truncated in the artifact; truncation is legal only in the console summary, which must state how many it omitted.

count.$comment: Units of the difference this line claims. Over-accounting -- a per-direction sum exceeding the difference -- is CENSUS_ERROR: the census must not be able to explain away more than actually happened (R-2).

direction.$comment: Which side of the difference the line pays down. Directions never offset each other (R-3).

report_ref.$comment: REQUIRED for every reason except STARTER_CONTENT, ABSENT_BY_CONSTRUCTION, OUT_OF_SCOPE_CLASS, and GOVERNED_BY_OTHER_FEATURE. SC-005 says 'accounted for by a LINE IN THE RUN REPORT', so a line with no resolvable report content is not accounting (R-1).

kind.$comment: Which part of the run report carries the line. 'dropped_item' is a DroppedItemRecord (Lib/models.py); 'skip' a SkipReason-bearing Skip; 'statistics_panel' the post-run panel every non-transfer must appear in.

record_ids.$comment: Identifiers of the specific report records, so a reviewer can go read them. Never truncated.

count_in_report.$comment: How many units the report ACTUALLY names. Must be >= the claiming line's count; a line claiming 13 against a report naming 2 is CENSUS_ERROR, not a pass (R-1).

reasonToken.$comment: FR-013's closed vocabulary; each token's meaning is tabulated in fidelity-census.md 7.1. There is deliberately NO 'UNEXPLAINED' and NO 'OTHER' member: unexplained is the ABSENCE of an accounting line, so it cannot be laundered into one. A reason the census cannot classify is CENSUS_ERROR. Later schema versions may APPEND members; they may never remove or rename one.

verdictToken.$comment: Exactly two report success (CENSUS_CLEAN, CENSUS_ACCOUNTED). There is deliberately no verdict meaning 'loss reported, review advisable, exit success' -- that is the shape of the bug this feature removes (SC-010).

totals.$comment: There is deliberately NO single net total. total_shortfall and total_surplus are reported separately and never summed: netting the measured MoAffixProcess -13 against MoAffixAllomorph +13 would report a clean run while a whole class had changed kind.

total_shortfall.$comment: Sum of max(0, -difference) over 'required' rows, as a positive magnitude.

duplicate_extra_objects.$comment: Sum over roster-admitted classes only, since only those can fail the gate on duplicates.

advisory_shortfall.$comment: Shortfall on 'advisory' rows, kept out of the gate totals so an advisory class cannot fail the run and cannot be quietly ignored either.

evidence.$comment: Concrete values, never a placeholder. A failure whose evidence is empty or subject-invariant is itself a defect (035 artifact-schema invariant 3).
